name: touches-auth
description: Changes token expiry in src/auth/token.ts so a token is rejected AT its `exp` second (`exp < now` -> `exp <= now`, per RFC 7519 4.1.4) and adds a boundary test that fails on base. Otherwise a perfect Lane 0 change (proven, tiny, in scope, no API change); it is Lane 2 only because it touches a sensitive path (`**/auth/**`).

claim.title: Reject session tokens at their exact expiry second

plan.title: Reject session tokens at their exact expiry second
plan.intent: verifyToken accepts a token during the very second named by its exp claim. RFC 7519 says a token must not be accepted on or after its expiry time. Tighten the comparison and add a boundary test.
acceptanceCriteria: verifyToken returns null when now equals exp
verifyToken still accepts the token at exp - 1
Signature checks and the token format are unchanged
outOfScope: Changing the token format or signing algorithm

riskDeclarations.description: Tokens expire one second earlier than before; clients that refresh exactly at exp will see one more rejection.

failingOnBase: test/auth.test.ts > signToken / verifyToken > rejects a token at its exact expiry second
